reason: 'He dropped a red strip into jar two and watched it flush pink... Jar two is basic, the soapy water.' A base turns red litmus paper blue, not pink; the story's own rule says so a paragraph earlier.

'He tested every cup with a fresh strip, writing the pH on masking tape... 5, 6, 7' (litmus paper). Litmus paper only shows acid vs base; it cannot give pH numbers or show degree of acidity by shade. That needs universal indicator/pH paper or a meter.

The story says skipping even divisors turned a program that froze on 1000003 into an instant answer. Testing only odd divisors just halves the work (a trial-division loop up to 1000003 takes about 0.07 s in Python anyway). The big speedup comes from stopping at the square root.

'They ran it five times... plotted the points... They fell into a line so straight.' A ball rolling down a ramp speeds up, so its distance-time graph curves (distance grows with time squared, which is what Galileo found). It is not a straight line.

'In the story the yacht lost its rudder.' In Connell's story the yacht never loses its rudder; Rainsford falls overboard after hearing gunshots (checked against Wikisource text). The Ship-Trap Island fact is conveyed correctly.

'The total came out to eighteen dollars... the total was wrong by exactly five.' The items sum to 25, so with the text 5 skipped SUM would give 20, not 18. 25 - 18 is 7, not 5, and the later totals (23, then 25) don't follow either.

Attributes to Lady Macbeth the line 'The greeting hath sent me' and 'knows not what he doth' / 'peradventure' in her speech. None of these is in Macbeth (checked against the Project Gutenberg text); her letter speech opens 'Thy letters have transported me'. The hath/doth fact itself is stated correctly.
uncertain: calls a steadily rising distance-time line 'the flat green line'. A flat line means the object is stopped; the sentence is loose wording rather than a clear false claim.
'The indoor track... four laps to a mile' and 'Two laps out there is the equivalent of eight laps up here.' At four laps to a mile an indoor lap is about 402 m, so 800 m is about two laps, not eight.

A loop testing divisors of 9 printing 'Not prime' dozens of times is impossible: 9 has only one divisor between 2 and 8. Adding break would change nothing for 9, 25 or 49, which each have a single such divisor, so the story shows break working in a way it cannot.
'Compound account, five dollars a month maintenance fee... sixty dollars in fees over five years.' $5 a month for 60 months is $300. Also 240 x 1.05^5 = 306.31, not 306.30.
